title: Tawtheeq
boardDescription: Register concluded contracts, review certificates and resolve differences.
syntheticNote: Synthetic records for practice. No portal registration is performed here.
noRecords: No Tawtheeq records yet. Records appear for concluded contracts.
loadError: Could not load Tawtheeq. Retry to load the latest record.
offline: You are offline. Your entries stay here; reconnect before submitting.
notPermitted: Tawtheeq is not available in this capacity
portalHelp: Use the concluded contract values below when registering on DARI. Confirm submission after entering them on the portal.
attestCheck: I entered these values on the DARI portal
skipGate: The owner must confirm skipping. This record stays awaiting registration until confirmation.
skipPending: Owner confirmation requested for skipping. Registration remains pending.
uploadHelp: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 20 MB. Upload the registered certificate, with all fields legible.
fileInvalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or PDF between 1 byte and 20 MB.
completing: Verifying the uploaded file and scan…
checksumFailed: The checksum did not match. Select the original file and upload it again.
scanRejected: The file failed the integrity or malware check. Replace it with a clean certificate.
scanPending: The scan is pending. Keep this page open and check again before extraction.
uploadFailed: The upload failed. Your file selection is kept; retry the upload.
reviewHelp: Check each value beside the source. Confirm or edit every critical field before submitting.
noEvidence: No printed evidence supplied. Enter the value from the source.
manualReason: Extraction is unavailable. Enter the certificate fields manually. Reason: {reason}
manual_entry: Manual review is required for this source.
sourceUnavailable: The source could not be loaded. Retry before confirming the fields.
pdfHelp: View the PDF beside the fields. If the embedded viewer is unavailable, open the certificate in another tab.
comparisonHelp: Both values remain visible. Resolve every open difference with a reason.
equivalentDisabled: Not allowed for amounts, dates or ID numbers
ownerConsequence: The owner re-approves the adopted material value. The current contract version stays until approval.
currentConsequence: A new contract version becomes current with the adopted value.
cancelConsequence: Cancel the registration on the portal and register again. This record returns to awaiting registration; both values remain in its history.
equivalentConsequence: Both values and your reason are retained as equivalent. No contract value changes.
identityTitle: This certificate belongs to a different identity
identityHelp: The upload was rejected. Compare the identifiers below and replace the certificate.
registeredSuccess: The certificate is registered and the review is complete.
errorTitle: The action could not be completed
errorHelp: Your entries are kept. Correct the highlighted fields or retry this action.
stale: The record changed. Reload the latest record before trying again.
csrf: The session check failed. Reload this page and retry.
forbidden: This action is not permitted in your current capacity.
unavailable: The service is unavailable. Your entries are kept; retry shortly.
expiredUpload: The upload link expired. Select the file again to request a new link.
historyNotPermitted: Version history is available only to managers and company administrators in this release. Owners and tenants cannot access history.
skipWarning: Not verified: under Administrative Decision No. 97 of 2012, Art. 4, only registered contracts are recognised by the authorities.
ownerDecisionConsequence: Approving makes the adopted version current and marks this Tawtheeq record as Registered. Returning keeps the prior contract version and returns the record for registration.
ownerSession: Decide in your own signed-in owner session. Your decision is recorded against the adopted version.
skipOwnerConsequence: Your confirmation allows the manager to complete the skip. Registration remains pending until the manager records it.
